TC-21/S05.title: Badge x context -> pre-selected template
TC-21/S05.detail: Local 25acd727, picker read closed after each badge change through the chart header. 8/8 judged: Hospital New Admission -> H&P, Follow-up -> SOAP progress, Consult -> Consult note; Nursing Home New Admission -> SNF admission, Follow-up -> SNF follow-up, Consult -> SNF consult (the cell that was a known gap until this build: SNF consult now exists and is pre-selected); a discharge template is never pre-selected; with Consult set the picker still changes by hand in both contexts and the badge stays Consult (U4).
